_doc: Cosmetic hero skins (docs/dev/skins.md): four packs, each covering all 15 heroes. Cosmetic only: no stats. 'art' names the folder under assets/art/heroes/<hero>/skins/; a skin whose art is not installed yet is listed as coming soon and cannot be bought. Prices are in gems (330 gems = $4.99 in the shop). Art prompts: the 'skins' block of data/art_prompts.json. After Dark is implied topless (never visible nipples), for the sideloaded build (Apple 1.1.4 risk).
